task.name: Begin_Dominatrix_shift
task.when: At the start of each Dominatrix shift

step.action: Receive the outgoing Dominatrix's verbal handoff.
Read every unresolved entry in 📦 Camp_Issue_Log.
Take one charged radio from 🔧 Camp_Radios.
Use 📦 Black_Rock_City_Map to identify the nearest medical station and Ranger outpost.
step.expectedResult: Medical stations are at 5:15 and Esplanade, 3:00 and C, and 9:00 and C; Ranger stations are at 6:30 and Esplanade, 3:00 and C, and 9:00 and C.

step.action: Physically locate 📦 Fire_Extinguishers, 📦 Fire_Blankets, 📦 First_Aid_Kits, and 📦 Naloxone_Nasal_Spray using 📦 Camp_Map.
Read the directions supplied with 📦 Naloxone_Nasal_Spray.

passWhen.criterion: The outgoing handoff and unresolved issues were reviewed.
The Dominatrix has a charged radio.
The Dominatrix can identify the nearest medical and Ranger stations.
The Dominatrix can point to every listed camp emergency resource.

reasoning.entry: The workbook's emergency-orientation rows are combined because they form one start-of-shift readiness outcome.
Current 2026 official locations replace prior-year station locations.
